# American Fidelity Employee Benefits Portal

> Official American Fidelity Assurance Company employee benefits portal at secured-americanfidelity.com. Manage supplemental insurance, file disability, cancer, accident, and life insurance claims, enroll in benefits, and access your account online.

## About

American Fidelity Assurance Company is a private supplemental insurance provider headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. Founded in 1960, American Fidelity serves employees in education, public sector, healthcare, and auto dealerships through employer-sponsored voluntary benefit programs. This portal at secured-americanfidelity.com provides policyholders and participants with secure access to their supplemental insurance benefits.

## Insurance Products

- [Disability Insurance (STD & LTD)](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/disability-insurance): Income replacement coverage when illness or injury prevents work, with short-term (3-6 months) and long-term (up to retirement) options
- [Cancer Insurance](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/cancer-insurance): Lump-sum and treatment cash benefits upon cancer diagnosis, paid regardless of other insurance
- [Accident Insurance](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/accident-insurance): Cash benefits for accidental injuries including fractures, dislocations, ER visits, and surgery
- [Critical Illness Insurance](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/critical-illness-insurance): Lump-sum payment on diagnosis of heart attack, stroke, organ transplant, kidney failure, and other covered conditions
- [Hospital Indemnity Insurance](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/hospital-indemnity-insurance): Daily cash benefit for hospital stays, ICU confinement, and outpatient surgery
- [Life Insurance & AD&D](https://secured-americanfidelity.com/life-insurance): Basic, supplemental, and dependent life insurance plus accidental death & dismemberment coverage
